articles.summary: We passed our SOC 2 Type 2 audit. That means our security controls not only look good on paper (Type 1), but actually work in practice (Type 2). From Firecracker-isolated ephemeral VMs to tight access controls and disaster recovery, we take your data seriously. Security isn’t a checkbox — it’s the product.
articles.title: Blacksmith achieves SOC 2 Type 2 compliance
